name: Effinger Health PA
setting: Facility-based: hospital, nursing facilities and assisted living

profile.entity: Florida professional association taxed as an S corporation
profile.clinicians: One physician-owner (family medicine) and one nurse practitioner
profile.sites: One hospital, five nursing facilities and seven assisted living facilities in the latest charge feed
profile.payers: Medicare fee-for-service is 55.5% of charges. UnitedHealthcare, Humana, Capital Health Plan and Florida Blue, with UnitedHealthcare's plan for people who have both Medicare and Medicaid, are about 25%. These insurers sell Medicare Advantage plans, and the data does not yet say how much of the 25% is Medicare Advantage. Medicaid plans and Florida Medicaid are about 6%. Veterans Affairs is 0.9%. 11.2% of feed dollars sat on charts the insurance check held (counted after the check ran); 138 of 1,037 feed visits arrived with no open plan on the chart (November 10, 2026).
profile.systems: AdvancedMD, Claimocity, Stedi, QuickBooks, a HIPAA-enabled Neon database, and software agents that run billing every 2 to 6 hours
